rule: An exemption drops a finding only when every byte of the finding's span lies in a part or Change row that exempts its rule; a match that runs out of a kit-written part, a base-held or kit-record row, or a display name into other text is reported. A finding is still labelled with the part, and named with the row's path, where its span starts.
